info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Employer Payroll Service-spec
info.description: The Employer Payroll Service Update API allows organizations to modify existing payroll service configurations for specific employers. This endpoint is essential for businesses seeking to adjust payroll parameters, ensuring compliance with evolving regulations or internal policy changes. Typical consumers include HR departments and payroll administrators who require efficient management of payroll settings. By providing this functionality, the API facilitates smoother operations and enhances the accuracy of payroll processing.

put.description: This operation allows for the updating of payroll services associated with a specific employer. It is essential for ensuring that employer payroll information is current and compliant with regulations.

requestBody.description: Updates the payroll services for the specified employer. Ensure that the payload adheres to the defined schema to process the request successfully.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the payroll service has been updated.
